conclusions: All sixteen live Super calls returned complete JSON with known usage. No provider failure, retry, truncation or local delivery block was observed.
Both arms produced five native-IR rejections, three executed but incorrect candidates, and zero independently accepted solutions. Four stages were graded; four attempted stages remained ungraded.

Optional bounds eliminated PHASE_BOUND rejections in this epoch (four in control, zero in treatment), but treatment retained four EXPRESSION_SHAPE rejections with duplicate expression identifiers and one EXPRESSION_SOURCE_NOT_BOUND rejection. This is a specific interface diagnosis, not an overall emission gain.

Treatment consumed 38418 reported tokens against 35678 for control. Only two of four pairs satisfied the predeclared five-percent realized-token matching tolerance; no pair used no more treatment compute.
The six executable proposals failed the unchanged independent mathematical oracle. Rejected proposals did not reach that oracle; they are not hidden reasoning failures.
Only bounded counts were retained for rejected IR. Raw mathematical programs were not retained, so the six functional failures cannot be localized to a specific equation from this report.

These are four new public parameter cases in two known formal families, not family-disjoint generalization or an official benchmark score. No default, authority, capability promotion or recursion claim is justified.
